subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — FinovateBank
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — FinovateBank

Hi Jordan — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum.

Call recap (30 min):
- Primary use case: automated partial underwriting and real-time guidance to loan officers (improve throughput, reduce manual review).
- Decision criteria you called out: latency (p95 under 200ms for short prompts), consistent cost per 1k tokens, SOC2 + data flow isolation, ability to run in your VPC for regulated data.
- Stakeholders you mentioned: Aisha Patel (VP Engineering), Procurement, Security/InfoSec. Economic buyer likely under CFO / Head of Ops based on procurement process.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm stakeholder list & procurement path — can you confirm who will own procurement and InfoSec checklist?
2) Share SOC2 snapshot and short data flow diagram (attached our SOC2_responses_v2.pdf and a 1-page stakeholder map image).
3) Intro internal enablement catch-up: suggests a 30-min internal session where we arm your champion (you/the IR team) with ROI talking points + tabletop demo plan.
4) POC scope suggestion: 4-week POC using dedicated capacity, sample workload, success metrics: latency, cost per 1k tokens, and qualitative accuracy score.

If you can confirm stakeholders and preferred timeline this week we can draft a mutual action plan (MAP) and share an ROI calc for your finance partner.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a short internal note to my SE and GTM lead to prepare the enablement pack.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0147

Attachments: stakeholder_map_v1.png, SOC2_responses_v2.pdf

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Short answers and next items from our side: 

Stakeholders (confirming):
- Aisha Patel, VP Engineering (technical sponsor) — aisha.patel@finovatebank.com
- Rajesh Menon, Head of Operations (economic buyer) — rajesh.menon@finovatebank.com
- Procurement Team — procurement@finovatebank.com
- InfoSec: security-triage@finovatebank.com (they've asked for SOC2 + data flow + encryption details)

Timeline: Procurement wants an initial SOW + pricing by July 1. POC preferred in July if security sign-off is quick.

Requests from Security/Procurement: 
- SOC2 report (or SOC2 scope) and answers to a short questionnaire (we attached our procurement checklist).
- Clarify whether Redwood will support VPC/Private deployment (yes/no) and KMS/HSM integration.

I've attached a procurement_checklist.docx with the fields our contracting team will flag. Can you confirm SOC2 docs and a data flow diagram? Also share a 1-page ROI summary we can route to Rajesh.

Jordan

FinovateBank

Folks — forwarding Jordan's note and procurement checklist. Need a fast enablement pack for our champion and a proposed POC scoping doc. High-level asks:

- Priyom: can you build a 1-pager talk track + 10-min demo plan that highlights latency, deterministic cost (per 1k tokens), and the private deployment option? Also include the minimum telemetry/security artifacts InfoSec will ask for.
- Rishi: procurement timeline looks like July 1 deadline for SOW/pricing; can you recommend a contract approach (term, discount band, support SLA) so we can route to procurement?
- Vivek: please review the SOC2 responses attached and flag any gaps for compliance questions.

I'll draft the mutual action plan (MAP) and ROI notionally; attaching an early ROI_calc_v1.xlsx — please update with realistic throughput assumptions and cost estimates for a 4-week POC.

Thanks — ideally we have a one-page enablement + ROI by EOD Friday so Jordan can circulate to Rajesh and Procurement.

Marissa

Attachments: ROI_calc_v1.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — FinovateBank

Thanks Marissa — putting notes here for the enablement doc and demo plan. I'll prepare a short slide + demo script. High-level technical points and talk tracks:

Talk tracks (for Jordan/Aisha to use):
- Performance: show 95th-percentile latency under 200ms for 256-token prompts on Dedicated with Dynamic Batching disabled + tail-latency optimizations.
- Cost predictability: demonstrate per-1k token unit economics and how caching/prefix sharing will reduce calls for repeat prompts.
- Security: highlight Private deployment option (VPC peering), KMS integration for key management, and audit logs. Attach the SOC2 excerpt and sample data flow diagram in the enablement slide.

POC scope suggestion (4 weeks):
Week 0: kickoff, access and sample dataset ingestion (anonymized), success criteria signoff
Week 1-2: run baseline evaluation vs current system, measure p95 latency, throughput, and cost per 1k tokens
Week 3: integrate sample UI and collect qualitative feedback from loan officers
Week 4: run final evaluation, ROI write-up, and executive readout.

Security artifacts we need to include: SOC2 summary, encryption at rest/in transit notes, data retention policy, and a minimal threat model. I can produce stub slides for each.

I'll have a 1-page enablement doc and demo script by EOD today and a sample metric dashboard for the POC.

— Priyom
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

This looks good — quick notes from GTM:

- Discount/contract: recommend a standard 12-month POC contract with a pilot discount of 25% and an addendum for Dedicated capacity pricing during the POC. Include an SLA at pilot tier (99.5% uptime) and 30-day termination for convenience.
- Mutual Action Plan (MAP): I'll draft a MAP with milestones (SOW to Procurement by 2027-06-30, Security review complete by 2027-07-07, POC start 2027-07-12).
- Champion enablement: Priyom's 1-pager + a 15-min dry run with Jordan/Aisha looks ideal. Priyom — can you block 30 mins for a dry run next week?

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/HB-2027-045 (deal), DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/finovatebank-ds

I'll coordinate the SOW pricing sheet and forward to Procurement. Good job moving this quickly — let's hit the July timeline.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
